request.name: Fix ChatView.vue - Sidebar expansion on click
request.content:
## Issue
The sidebar in ChatView.vue does not expand when clicking anywhere on it. Currently, it likely only expands on specific elements.

## Requirements
- Sidebar must expand/toggle on any click within the sidebar area
- Ensure click event handlers are properly attached to the container
- Maintain existing expanded/collapsed states

## Acceptance Criteria
✓ Clicking anywhere in the sidebar toggles expansion state
✓ No console errors on click events
✓ Sidebar state persists correctly
✓ Does not interfere with other interactive elements (buttons, links)

request.name: Fix ChatView.vue - Create subtask inheritance
request.content:
## Issue
When creating a subtask in ChatView.vue, the new subtask should inherit `project_id` and `profiles` from the parent task, but currently it does not.

## Requirements
- Subtask creation must copy `project_id` from parent task
- Subtask creation must copy `profiles` from parent task
- Maintain parent-child relationship for these attributes
- Ensure data is passed correctly to subtask component

## Acceptance Criteria
✓ New subtasks inherit parent project_id
✓ New subtasks inherit parent profiles
✓ Child tasks properly reference parent task
✓ Data inheritance works across component hierarchy

request.name: Refactor Chat.vue - Use Collapsible for file list and profiles
request.content:
## Issue
Chat.vue needs to use Collapsible component for better UI organization:
- File list should be collapsible (truncated in header, expandable in detail)
- Profiles section should use collapsible component
- List should appear in header when collapsed

## Requirements
- Replace static file list with Collapsible component
- Implement header truncation when collapsed
- Show preview/summary in header
- Expand to full list on detail view
- Apply same pattern to profiles section
- Maintain all existing functionality

## Acceptance Criteria
✓ File list uses Collapsible component
✓ Profiles section uses Collapsible component
✓ Header shows truncated list/summary when collapsed
✓ Full list visible when expanded
✓ No data loss or functionality regression
✓ Responsive on mobile and desktop

request.content:

MainMenu component needs to:

2. Ensure each app has a proper route for single/detail view
3. Remove or handle desktop-only apps appropriately

## Requirements
- List all apps available in the system
- Create/verify routes for single app view (app/:id or similar)
- Remove desktop-specific dependencies that block mobile/single view
- Ensure smooth navigation between apps
- Handle missing or unavailable apps gracefully

✓ Each app has a functioning single-view route
✓ No desktop-only blocking for mobile users
✓ Navigation between apps works smoothly
✓ Links don't break when navigating between single app views
✓ Proper error handling for missing apps
